title: Kai Sotto expected to join Gilas early for Malaysia buildup

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Kai Sotto is expected to be among those who will report early for Gilas Pilipinas’ preparation for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers in Seremban, Malaysia. Coach Tim Cone said Sotto will join the contingent flying to Malaysia on November 21, where Gilas will hold its buildup before the crucial games against Syria and Iran.
